source.role: Only product reference; owner-selected intended design, not a manufacturing certificate.

reference_style: R40 four square material/construction macro photographs, studied locally under reference-style-only. R40 image files are never passed as model inputs.
claim_limits: Illustrative details of selected design; not actual factory documentary photographs.
No manufacturing days, certifications, leather grade, hidden construction or calibrated dimensions asserted.

panels.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup, identity-preserving macro photography. Make ONE square editorial detail photograph for the Velantra Vivienne homepage. The attached image is the sole PRODUCT IDENTITY reference: the owner-selected September 3 Chocolate Vivienne master. It establishes intended visible design, not factory measurement or certification. The requested view is a TIGHT CROP of an existing visible surface, not a whole-bag view, a new design, a new camera orbit, or an assembly diagram. Keep the same dark chocolate pore grain, soft slouch and natural folds, smoother warmer cognac-brown contrast trim, dark brown thread, edge thickness and local sheen wherever visible. Preserve the selected master geometry in the visible crop; never add a feature merely because it was described outside that crop. Photorealistic 100 mm macro lens, elegant warm-neutral atelier editorial light: broad soft window light from upper left, gentle fill, soft realistic highlights and deep but readable contact shadows, neutral cream only where background is visible. True fine surface detail, quiet restrained color, no orange filter, no plastic CGI polish. No people, hands, tools, machines, labels, logos, text, watermark, certification marks, dimension markings, new compartments, interior, backside or invented hardware. No white contrast stitching, no canvas, no suede. Deliver one finished square image with no border or collage.

SPECIFIC SHOT: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the existing lower front leather body, its soft organic crease, and the curving warm cognac corner reinforcement at the lower right of the selected reference. The composition should read almost abstractly as supple dark chocolate grain meeting smoother warm brown trim: a broad softly lit curved fold crosses the frame, deep pore grain is crisp in the focal plane, the diagonal curving edge of the actual corner cap enters the lower right. Do not show the full bag, handles, hardware, detached swatches or unseen cut edges. Keep the exact visible seam curve and the local material/trim contrast. Product fills the entire frame.
panels.alt: Close-up of the Vivienne’s Chocolate leather grain and contrasting corner trim.

visual_review.verdict: Reference-relative detail fidelity accepted; not physical manufacturing or metric-scale certification.
visual_review.note: Dark Chocolate fine grain, soft front crease, cognac corner-cap contrast and curved seam preserved. Extreme material crop; no new hardware or hidden surface.

web_export.processing: Uniform downsample and JPEG encoding only; no content edits, color edits or baked crop.
